lesson.subtitle: Lesson 6 -- What Do You Like? Movies, Music and Weekends
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Giovanna de Fátima | Lesson 6 -- What Do You Like?
lesson.grammar_point: like / love / hate + verb-ing (I like watching series)

listenings.text: I love watching series. My favorite is a police series from the United States. I watch one episode every night, after dinner. I do not like action movies. For me they are boring, and they are always very long. On Friday I watch a movie with my sister, and she chooses. That is the rule.

Music is my life. I listen to music all day. In the office I like listening to rock, because it is fast and I work fast. In the car I listen to samba, because the traffic is terrible and samba is happy. I hate silence. On Saturday I go to a party with my friends, and there is always music.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna finishes work on Friday. She is free for the weekend. On Saturday she goes to a party with her friends. On Sunday she watches a movie at home. On Sunday night she chooses a new series.

paras: Carla loves watching series. She watches one episode every night, after dinner. She does not like action movies. She says they are boring.
Paulo likes listening to music at work. He listens to rock in the office and to samba in the car. He hates silence.
Daniel loves going to parties, but he is not free on Saturday. His favorite thing is a long walk in the park with his wife.
And Giovanna? She likes going to parties and to the movies. Her favorite free time is Saturday night with her boyfriend.
